categories.main_business_segments: C&D International Investment Group Limited primarily engages in property development, real estate industry chain investment services, and emerging industry investments in China. The Group's business spans property development, property management services, construction management, and entrusted construction services, with property development being the main revenue source.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The Group employs advanced technologies such as Building Information Modelling (BIM), prefabricated construction techniques including hollow slab composite shear walls (EVE and EMC technologies), prefabricated elevator pit bases, gypsum-based self-leveling flooring, triple-glazed double-cavity glass, and aluminium-clad timber passive windows. It also integrates smart home systems with intelligent lighting, curtain, and air conditioning controls, and uses digital quality management systems to enhance construction efficiency and product quality.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The Group serves property buyers and owners primarily in China, focusing on residential and commercial real estate markets. It also provides property management and construction management services to subsidiaries, joint ventures, and associates within its industrial chain. The Group targets customers demanding high-quality housing with emphasis on location, functionality, and supporting facilities, mainly in core urban areas.
categories.geographic_coverage: The Group operates mainly in China with key cities including Xiamen, Shanghai, Beijing, Hangzhou, Fuzhou, Chengdu, Ningbo, and others. It has a registered office in the Cayman Islands and principal places of business in Hong Kong and mainland China, with projects and operations spanning multiple provinces and urban clusters such as the Greater Bay Area and Yangtze River Delta.
categories.supply_chain_position: C&D International Investment Group operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the real estate supply chain, including property development, property management, construction management, and entrusted construction services. It also engages in upstream activities such as land acquisition and raw material procurement, integrating supply chain management with centralized procurement platforms and green sourcing.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The Group's strategic focus is on innovation-driven development, emphasizing product and technological innovation to enhance competitiveness. It invests in R&D to upgrade product lines, integrates cutting-edge technologies like smart building and green construction, and accelerates supply chain platform development for resource integration and efficiency. The Group also prioritizes digital transformation, sustainable development, and ESG integration.
categories.revenue_model: The Group generates revenue mainly through property sales, accounting for approximately 97% of total revenue. Additional income streams include property management services, construction management services, entrusted construction management, and commercial property operation management. Revenue is derived from contracted sales, property delivery, and service fees from related real estate industry chain businesses.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: While specific competitors are not named, the Group positions itself as a leading comprehensive real estate developer with strong capabilities in product quality, service excellence, operational efficiency, and innovation. It competes by leveraging diversified strengths across product design, technology, supply chain, and brand reputation, aiming to maintain market leadership in core urban areas amidst a challenging real estate market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the Group achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB142.99 billion, a 6.4% increase year-on-year, with profit attributable to owners of RMB4.80 billion, a slight decrease of 4.6%. Total assets stood at RMB412.48 billion with a healthy asset structure. The Group maintains a prudent financing policy with net debt to equity ratio around 31.78%, and continues to expand land reserves and project portfolio across key Chinese cities.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The Group emphasizes high product quality, innovative design integrating traditional Chinese culture with modern aesthetics, and smart home technologies to deliver differentiated living experiences. It focuses on customer-centric services, refined design, green and low-carbon building practices, and comprehensive quality management systems. The Group also highlights its commitment to ESG principles, sustainable development, and building harmonious communities as key differentiators.
